programme.title: E1 - From Lab To Field
programme.desc: Joelle and Theo, qualified chemists, specialised in plants, have chosen a new life. They have traded in their white coats for organic farmer boots in a community farm in the Franches-Montagnes. A choice fed by their love of plants and one that they don't regret.

programme.title: E11 - Granville, The Monaco Of The North
programme.desc: Aboard a Citroen convertible, Laurent visits Granville, one of Normandy's most popular seaside resorts. Famous for its carnival, he meets Yann to discover the secrets of the floats. Michel enjoys a ride in an amazing convertible.

programme.title: E2 - Jo Fontaine, From Earth To Stone
programme.desc: Jo Fontaine wanted to be a farmer like his father, on the family land in his village near Geneva. But at 20, he discovered sculpture, and it was an 'explosion in his head', a revelation. From the outset, he chose to express himself on stone, in sometimes monumental works.

programme.title: E31
programme.desc: 從事心理健康指導工作的劉瑕路遇一名男子想要跳樓，劉瑕見狀便用心理學知識進行疏導，最後成功將該男子救下。這一幕恰巧被正想將自己的心理推理小說改編成劇本的作家祁連山目睹，便力邀劉瑕當顧問。為實現幫助更多人的理想，劉瑕成立了自己的工作室，以出色的專業水準和共情能力，為因事業、家庭或情感問題感到心理壓力的來訪者排憂解困，幫助他們恢復健康積極的生活。祁連山的小說在改編成影視劇的過程中得到了劉瑕的專業指導。隨著兩人接觸不斷加深，他深深地被劉瑕吸引。劉瑕工作之餘，與天才極客沈欽合作開發AI心理測試系統，並將之應用於兒童及社區公益，效果極佳。祁連山也逐漸參與到劉瑕的公益事業中，一起幫助那些面臨生活挑戰的人走出心理困境。二人在一次次攜手合作中越走越近，最終在各自事業都取得成功的同時，也收穫了美好的愛情。

programme.title: How Does Being A Teenager In A Refugee Camp In Greece Shape Your Life?
programme.desc: Fadia fled Afghanistan at 16, survived a dangerous journey through Iran and Turkey, and spent a year at the Ritsona refugee camp in Greece before eventually reaching Germany. Around five years later, she returns - only to find the gates still closed to her. Today, Fadia volunteers with ROSA, a charity that creates safe spaces for women in refugee camps around Athens.

programme.title: Baogu At the Movie E214 -12.12: THE DAY
programme.desc: Baogu At The Movie brings you the most exclusive behind the scenes of recent local blockbusters. The most true story and sincere conversation behind every piece of dreamwork.

programme.title: The Narrow Road
programme.desc: Under this flashy city, amidst the numbness of frustrations, what people are looking forward to is the glimmer of light that might change their lives. Chak, who runs a small cleaning company, barely takes over the cleaning work on his own to make a living. Hitting by the COVID-19 pandemic, small business closed down one by one. One day, a young single mother, Candy, comes to look for a job opportunity from Chak. She doesn't seem like a trustworthy person to Chak, unexpectedly, she helps Chak to resolve many difficulties at work. Life seems like get back on track. The morning sun never lasts a day, Chak's company is being accused, at the same time, his family is facing a nightmare as well, all his hopes are dashed to pieces, but they can still try their best to resist the oppression of life and support each other through this painful year.

programme.title: Director’s Premiere -Nick Cheuk
programme.desc: New director Nick Cheuk who won four awards with his debut feature ‘Time Still Turns The Pages', advanced from a screenwriter to a director and have accomplished his movie dream with passion. However, it was not an easy job working three roles at a time especially it was his first time directing. How did he overcome all kinds of challenges during the process? In this interview, Nick will share his unforgettable moments during filming and also talk about his movie beliefs.

programme.title: That Demon Within
programme.desc: By a strange twist of fate, dutiful Hong Kong policeman Dave Wong saves the life of the leader of a violent gang of armed robbers. When they commit another crime, Dave is determined to put an end to their activities. He works with the leader, whom the gang had betrayed, to engineer a plan to wreak havoc within the gang and let the gangsters kill one another. But it becomes increasingly obvious to Dave and to his colleagues that Dave is suffering from a severe mental disorder, and Dave finds that instead of upholding the law as a righteous police officer, he has now become a fugitive wanted for murder.

programme.title: E1 - The Great Barrier Reef
programme.desc:
World champion freediver Marina Kazankova is on a mission, to free dive the Great Barrier Reef.
Capable of holding her breath for 7-minutes at a time, Marina travels to the iconic reef, swimming with turtles and giant groper, diving on ship wrecks and through awesome caves, all on a single breath of air.
Capturing each challenge in glorious 4K, this series brings you face to face with the very best of the Great Barrier Reef’s corals and creatures.

programme.title: E2 - Tigers (Circus Tigers)
programme.desc: The prestigious Wonderland Circus has become the second Spanish circus to voluntarily end its show with wild animals. Seven tigers have been donated to animal rights organisation Animal Advocacy and Protection (AAP). It’s the largest rescue of big cats in Spain to date. The tigers are first transported temporarily to AAP’s specialized rescue centre, Primadomus in Spain for their rehabilitation process. Here they are trained to enter their crate voluntarily so as to avoid sedation for the long journey to the Isle of Wight in the UK. The team are well prepared. With no hotel equipped to accommodate five adult tigers, they must make the 30-hour road trip nonstop! The transport crosses cinematic landscapes, through the northern Spanish countryside, across the French border, through the Pyrenees and across the iconic Millau Viaduct, the longest cable-stayed bridge in the world that crosses over the Tarn River in the South of France. It’s an epic journey with traffic delays on the outskirts

programme.title: E1
programme.desc: This film follows the inspiring relationship between whale whisperer Vicki Neville and the humpback whales of Australia. Never-before-seen behaviours have been documented by a team of five cinematographers over the three-month whale season in Hervey Bay, all captured in glorious 4K. These stunning close encounters capture whales like you have never seen them before!

programme.title: E4 - Southern New South Wales and the Australian Capital Territory
programme.desc: In this installment, we highlight the top experiences available in Southern New South Wales and the Australian Capital Territory. From the pristine waters of the Sapphire Coast to the snow-capped peaks of Mount Kosciuszko, there is so much to discover. Ride through the majestic Snowy Mountains on horseback, learn about the fascinating lifecycle of an oyster in Pambula and immerse yourself in an indigenous cultural tour in Australia’s capital city, Canberra.

programme.desc: Powerful industrial machines offer immense strength but carry deadly risks for those who use them.

programme.title: E2 - Tigers (Circus Tigers)
programme.desc: The prestigious Wonderland Circus has become the second Spanish circus to voluntarily end its show with wild animals. Seven tigers have been donated to animal rights organisation Animal Advocacy and Protection (AAP). It’s the largest rescue of big cats in Spain to date. The tigers are first transported temporarily to AAP’s specialized rescue centre, Primadomus in Spain for their rehabilitation process. Here they are trained to enter their crate voluntarily so as to avoid sedation for the long journey to the Isle of Wight in the UK. The team are well prepared. With no hotel equipped to accommodate five adult tigers, they must make the 30-hour road trip nonstop! The transport crosses cinematic landscapes, through the northern Spanish countryside, across the French border, through the Pyrenees and across the iconic Millau Viaduct, the longest cable-stayed bridge in the world that crosses over the Tarn River in the South of France. It’s an epic journey with traffic delays on the outskirts
